fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at 2990cabf5. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-start-new-main-clean$': PASS. The script starts a --new plan run and a --milestone plan run. For each one it checks that the run's worktree holds the open entry byte for byte and commits it at HEAD with a clean tree, that rhiza change show of the new change set succeeds from main, that check reports no commit-untracked or untracked entry, and that health shows main ok with no orphan, the held copy on its 'untracked log entries pending on a model branch or run' line, and no 'on no branch'. With RHIZA_TEST_MODEL_BRANCH=1 it also checks that no model/* branch is pushed and that the fake gh is never called. This fixes attempt 1's failing '! stdout untracked'. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestNewPlanChange: PASS (a dry run predicts the same change set ID and worktree and writes nothing to main). Neighbouring scripts also pass: run-start-new, model-commit-untracked, health*. Read the diff: newPlanChange writes the main copy through workspace.writeEntryUnshipped, which turns off the mirror and modelBranch hooks only for that write, so only the run's branch ships it.
